gloss: daytime type; morning person; diurnal lifestyle

definitions.gloss: daytime type; morning person; diurnal lifestyle
definitions.explanation: A person who is naturally active during the day and goes to bed early, or a lifestyle pattern centered around daytime hours. Contrasts with {夜型|よるがた} (night-owl type).

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昼型|ひるがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧です。

⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜型|よるがた}→夜型：20463_yorugata⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧になって{昼型|ひるがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}した→戻す：02317_modosu⟧。
examples.english: I was a night owl in college, but I switched back to a daytime schedule after starting work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{昼型|ひるがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えよう→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I'm thinking of switching to a daytime schedule for my health.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧ (daytime) and {型|がた} (type, pattern). Commonly used in discussions about sleep schedules, health, and lifestyle. In Japanese popular discourse, people often classify themselves as either {昼型|ひるがた} or ⟦{夜型|よるがた}→夜型：20463_yorugata⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昼型|ひるがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: daytime lifestyle
- {昼型|ひるがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧: a daytime person
- {昼型|ひるがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧: to switch to a daytime schedule
- {昼型|ひるがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧: to go back to a daytime schedule

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夜型|よるがた}→夜型：20463_yorugata⟧: night-owl type — the opposite lifestyle pattern
- ⟦{朝型|あさがた}→朝型：16867_asagata⟧: morning type — similar to {昼型|ひるがた} but emphasizes early rising specifically
